reports.title: Grand Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Fair on crankbaits, plastic baits, spinnerbaits around brush structure, shorelines.
White Crappie Fair on hair jigs, jigs around brush structure, docks.

reports.title: Konawa fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass Good on crankbaits, jerk baits, plastic baits around main lake, points, river channel, weed beds.

reports.title: Texoma fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Crappie Fair on caddis flies, hair jigs, jigs, minnows around brush structure, coves, docks, standing timber.
Crappie are are being caught on jigs around brush, piles and docks, and also being caught in coves with brush piles.

reports.title: Keystone Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs, minnows around brush structure, docks.
Largemouth Bass Good on crankbaits, in-line spinnerbaits, jerk baits, lipless baits, minnows, plastic baits, small lures, spinnerbaits around brush structure, main lake, points.

reports.title: McGee Creek fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on bill baits, crankbaits, in-line spinnerbaits, jigs, other around brush structure, rocks, standing timber.

reports.title: Broken Bow Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Smallmouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on Alabama rig, crankbaits, spinnerbaits, topwater lures around channels, coves.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs around brush structure.

reports.title: Hugo Lake fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie, White Crappie Slow on jigs, minnows, small lures around brush structure, channels, standing timber.

reports.title: Pine Creek Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Slow on crankbaits, lipless baits, plastic baits around coves, points.
White Crappie Slow on jigs, minnows around brush structure, main lake, standing timber.

reports.title: Sardis Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Good on bill baits, crankbaits, lipless baits, plastic baits, spinnerbaits around brush structure, points, shorelines, standing timber.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs, minnows around brush structure, standing timber.
